en: Deadman Danny, at your service.
My friend, you look like you're in need of a skeleton with a jetpack. And not just any jetpack, the Fairfax Industries Chimera Mark 1.
At Fairfax Industries, we say "All's Fair", but that's not true, because with the Fairfax Chimera Mark 1, you have the advantage.
Some people look at me and say that I am a salesman, but that is not true. A salesman's job is to sell products; I am a prophet. A man blessed and cursed with the duty of showing you the future.
Today, Zephyrs make airship flight possible- but what if there was a better way?
Ladies and gentlemen, the demonstration that you are about to see is extremely dangerous.

Fairfax industries has always been the vanguard of occult technology, but today, visionary Maximilian Fairfax, and genius Margaret McGinnis have crafted the thing of military dreams. It is my honor, it is my privilege, and I daresay it is the highlight of my career to present to you: The Chimera Mark 1!

My friends, there is a war ravaging North Ixia… and while we all pray for peace, for the safety of our countrymen in South Ixia we must prepare for war. To that end, I say: what better way to protect the 52nd state than with the Chimera Mark 1?
Now, this is not the first time that I have flown the Chimera Mark 1, but if Maggie did her job properly, then this will be the first time that I don't blow up doing so.
If you have never seen a skeleton soar through the heavens on the wings of a soul powered jetpack, you, my friends, are in for the treat of a lifetime.
Apologies, I have to go to Long Island to demonstrate a lip gloss that doubles as a corrosive acid.
I'd love to help, but I'm down a femur, both radii, and a good chunk of my spine after McGinnis had a great idea she wanted to try.
I don't need to summon the Patron, presenting fine Fairfax Industries products is reward enough.
Apologies, there is a corporate retreat on Cadenza that I must attend.
I am a company man, and it wouldn’t feel right to work for anyone who’s not Maximilian Fairfax.
I have a prior commitment today, there’s an elementary school that needs to learn about the dangers of fire elementals.
If I show up, I risk getting in Maggie‘s way, and that simply will not do.
The Chimera has a few more kinks that need to be worked out before I can give it a test run.
Sorry, my PTO already got approved.
My specialty is showing off the hardware, not actually using the hardware.
Yes

Yes

You know, buddy... I'm gonna let that one go because you are clearly out of your goddamn mind.
Yes

You oughta be ashamed of yourself, man.

Yes

Yes

Yes

Well--

Yes

Yes

Yes
You.
I see I left an impression.

Yes

Yes

You say that now, but please take my card in case ya change your mind.
Yes

Yes

You're pathetic.
Sir, I am employed.
Yes

How fortunate for me.
Yes

You may be tryin', but you sure as hell ain't succeedin'.
Yes
And how are you doing today?
Okay, I see I'll be the one doing the talking.

I can't help being exuberant about what I do!
You should try.
Yes

Yes

No.

Yes

I'm talking literally.

Yes

Sir, you're acting like I'm a punchline when I am not. My work, while theatrical at times, legitimately saves lives. And if that means I lose an arm in an unexpected blender calamity from time to time, so be it.
Yes
Do you like working for Fairfax Industries?

Without question.
Yes

I'd be interested...

Yes

Oh yes.
